title: Master Data Automation Initiative
shortDescription: A cross-company initiative to consolidate master-data requests that had previously been submitted separately for each company.
businessContext: The initiative covered 10 companies and master data for customers, vendors, employees, G/L accounts, banks, profit centers, and cost centers.
challenge: Master Data requests were submitted separately for each company.
solution: Consolidated Master Data requests across companies instead of handling a separate request for each company.
myRole: Contributed to the original business idea, business-requirements clarification, process design, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and solution development.
